summary.text: Sevier White, a Libertarian, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma to Kevin Hern.
He was previously the Libertarian candidate for Oklahoma's 4th Congressional District in 2016, and little else about his background is publicly documented.

paragraphs.text: White ran as the Libertarian candidate for U.S. House in Oklahoma's 4th District in 2016. In the November 8 general election he and Democrat Christina Owen lost to incumbent Rep. Tom Cole (R).
White has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
He was on the general-election ballot after the Libertarian Party's June 16, 2026, primary was canceled.
He received 0.9% of the vote to Kevin Hern's 57.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
